name: Blastverse: Block Nova
summary:
Blastverse: Block Nova is two games in one headset.

NOVA FIT - PUNCH, DUCK AND DODGE YOUR WAY FIT
- Blocks fly at you to the beat. Jab, hook, uppercut: every block shows the punch it wants.
- Duck under lasers, lean away from walls, squat down to the low blocks.
- 8 programmes: Boxing, Cardio, HIIT, Legs & Glutes, Core & Abs, Arms & Shoulders, Warm-up, Stretch & Cool-down.
- 3 to 20 minute sessions, 3 difficulty levels and a coach that cheers you on.
- Levels, daily streaks, a daily goal, the challenge of
